description: Changes a person's name, email or tag, by id or the exact name as the memory holds it — a miss answers with the real names; everything not named stays as it was, and an explicit null clears the email or the tag. `tag` is their role in the owner's finances — family, household help, landlord — from the member tags. A person carries a name, a tag, an email and linked accounts; details and card_name are longbook's own, and a set sending a non-empty one is refused. Renaming onto a name another person wears is refused rather than merged. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Changes screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

tag.description: Their role in the owner's finances — a member tag: family, household help, landlord. Null or "" clears.

name: update_member
title: Update a person
